name: Constant Heat
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, F (fist-sized piece of igneous rock)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 fist-sized piece of igneous rock
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell enchants a piece of igneous rock to unlock some of the heat that went into its creation, warming the surrounding area through convection.

When a fist-sized chunk of igneous rock is subjected to this spell, it glows red-hot and radiates heat sufficient to warm a 20-cubic-foot area to 70 degrees. If the rock is touched directly, it causes 1d4 points of fire damage per round of contact.
